item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.2.2

Security updates to your equity ledger — you must upgrade to this version to continue earning and viewing your equity.

  • Security updates to the equity page. Visit surge://equity for a real-time ledger of your equity in the cooperative. Watch your clicks and dividends update live as you browse, and explore it all through interactive charts that bring your stake to life.
  • Quick access, everywhere. You can access your equity in the menus and toolbar, so your ownership is always one click away.
